forgotBody: Nobody can look your password up — not even an admin. Ask an admin to send you a one-time reset link, then check your inbox.
notified: Admins notified. You'll get a reset link by email once one of them approves it.
notifiedPending: A request is already waiting for an admin.
cooldown: You've already asked today. You can ask again after {time}.
notifyFailed: Couldn't send the request. Try again in a moment.
contactHint: In a hurry? Reach an admin directly at {email}.
tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.
success: Password changed. You can sign in now.
invalidBody: It may have been mistyped, or replaced by a newer one. Ask an admin for a fresh link.
expiredBody: Reset links are valid for one hour. Ask an admin for a fresh one.
usedTitle: This link has already been used
usedBody: A password was already set with it. If that wasn't you, tell an admin immediately.
missingToken: This page needs a reset link to work. Open the link from your email.
adminSubtitle: People locked out of an area with its own password. Nothing changes until you issue a link.
adminUnknownAccountHint: Nothing matched this email — most likely a typo, possibly someone probing. Admins were not emailed.
adminMismatchHint: Whoever filed this isn't the person who owns the account. Confirm in person before issuing anything.
adminReverifyStale: Session not verified yet. Try once more.
adminLinkGoesTo: The link is emailed to the account holder, never to whoever asked.
